title: "{{TITLE}}"
description: ""
lang: {{LANG}}
date: {{DATE}}
tags: []
draft: true
---

<!--
  description  max 200 chars, shown in listings, RSS and the OG card
  translationKey  add the SAME value to the vi and en file to pair them for hreflang
  updated      optional, YYYY-MM-DD — adds dateModified to the BlogPosting schema
  cover        optional, path relative to this file; Astro validates it exists
  contentWarning  optional labels from src/lib/content-labels.ts, e.g. [politics] — a banner;
               the visual ones (horror, blood, violence…) also blur the post's images
  ageRating    optional "13+" | "16+" | "18+" — the text stays folded until the reader
               confirms their age
  draft: true  hidden in production, visible in `npm run dev`. Flip when ready.
-->
